name: Grilled Balsamic Steak Skewers, Greek Salad & Pita (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
If using wooden skewers, place 5 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them. (If you don't have skewers, you can cook the steak directly on the grill pan.)
Place oil, vinegar, Dijon, and spices in a medium bowl, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp balsamic vinegar
1 tsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp oregano, dried
¼ tsp garlic powder
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat steak dry with paper towels, cut into 1-inch cubes, and season with salt; thread onto skewers, place on a plate, and drizzle with half of the dressing, turning to coat. Set remaining dressing aside for the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
454 g striploin (New York strip) steak
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, add the skewers and cook, turning occasionally, until the steak is cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Remove to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 English cucumber
1 pint grape tomatoes
½ small bunch fresh dill

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, trim and seed bell peppers. Slice half a pepper lengthwise into thin strips and transfer to another plate. Cut remaining bell pepper into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim cucumber. Slice one-third crosswise into thin rounds and add to the plate with the bell pepper. Cut remaining cucumber into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl.
Halve grape tomatoes lengthwise. Add a ½-cup to the plate and set aside. Add remaining tomatoes to the bowl.
Peel and small dice shallot. Add to the bowl.
Drain and roughly chop olives. Add to the bowl, along with feta and crushed red pepper, then stir to combine the salad. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup Kalamata olives, pitted
½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl along with yogurt, water, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the yogurt sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup plain Greek yogurt
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Toast pita breads if desired, then cut each into 6 wedges.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Remove beef from 1 skewer (cut into smaller pieces if desired) and divide between plates along with 4 pita wedges, a ¼-cup of yogurt sauce, and veggies. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide remaining skewers, sauce, pita wedges, and salad between plates. Enjoy!
